body.name: Root-locus and realization handle for the \(K\)-frontier
body.construction: Starting move: represent every candidate dictionary by the component loci \((R_j(D))_{j=1}^{c}\), seek bounded certificates for an empty locus using half-tree intersections and root labels, and in the converse direction compile selector and compatibility incidences through \((\widetilde a_v,h_{uv},c_{uv})\). A compiled gadget is admissible only after the piecewise matrix with diagonal \(M_{xx}=\widetilde a_x\) and off-diagonal path products passes the arbitrary-root SEM covariance derivation, both directed residual identities on every edge, positive definiteness, nonzero-edge faithfulness, rationality, polynomial bit-length control, and enumeration of every internal root and auxiliary label.
